title: 3D Viewport shortcuts `Ctrl+1`/`Ctrl+2`/`Ctrl+3`/`Ctrl+4` stop working in some cases
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.8.dev1

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7085) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.80 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

At some point, I noticed that the shortcuts for changing the 3D viewport layout would randomly stop working. For a long time, I couldn't figure out why, but yesterday I managed to find a reproducible case. I think it depends on which viewport has focus before switching.

On my machine, pressing `Ctrl+4`, then placing the cursor over the top-right viewport, and finally pressing `Ctrl+3` consistently causes all subsequent shortcuts to stop working until I move the mouse cursor.

### Steps to reproduce

Good scenario:
1. Switch to the 4 Viewports layout in the 3D editor
2. Place the mouse cursor over the **top-left** viewport
3. Don't move the mouse anymore
4. Press `Ctrl+1`/`Ctrl+2`/`Ctrl+3`/`Ctrl+4` gently many times
5. Verify that the shortcuts work consistently

Bad scenario:
1. Switch to the 4 Viewports layout in the 3D editor
2. Place the mouse cursor over the **top-right** viewport
3. Don't move the mouse anymore
4. Smash `Ctrl+1`/`Ctrl+2`/`Ctrl+3`/`Ctrl+4` furiously
5. Eventually, the shortcuts stop working
